routing.required_fix: Go native: no existing provider/exporter. Propose NEW sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(sdktrace.WithBatcher(exporter)) with otel.SetTracerProvider and NEW otlptracehttp.New(ctx, supported options); use configured HTTP/protobuf endpoint, preserve future operator options. Proposed Go binding delegate implements ExportSpans(context.Context, []sdktrace.ReadOnlySpan) error and Shutdown(context.Context) error; embed sdktrace.ReadOnlySpan and override Resource() *resource.Resource, preserving all other methods. Snapshot validated binding per batch with headers through supported otlptracehttp.WithHeaders or a verified request transport hook; prove atomic update and absence of duplicates. SDK/provider ForceFlush(ctx)/Shutdown(ctx), context cancellation on resolver shutdown. No Python carrier APIs. Go module/toolchain/exporter-version compatibility remains unverified; do not claim dynamically mutable exporter headers without a public implementation test.
acceptance_criteria: Profile-to-process load before initialization; actual supported resource result -> consumed bootstrap -> selected exporter headers/payload or isolated lookup failure.

Fake application and all active telemetry sinks; exact RunAgent invocation, force_flush/shutdown or supported logger.terminate, pending completed spans drain, resources close, one node per source operation, at most one export per destination.
Fresh exact trace readback in selected destination is separate optional live proof; not executed.
